payload.name: Matching Law
payload.fact: In concurrent schedules of reinforcement, the ratio of responding is proportional to the ratio of reinforcement.

provenance.title: ON THE LAW OF EFFECT<sup>1</sup>
provenance.quote_or_locus: For concurrent schedules (i.e., simultaneous choice procedures), there is matching between the relative frequencies of responding and reinforcement
